blocks.text: Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs: ходить, ездить, летать usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb. However, prefixes "по-" and "с-" may form the perfective aspect with the "repeated function" verbs.

a) Prefix "по-" denoting a perfective action of limited duration (an action "for a while"): походить, поездить, полетать. *Он походил по комнате и сел за стол. Мы поездили по городу и поехали домой.* b) Prefix "с-" implying a single round trip: сходить, съездить, слетать. These verbs denote a single trip (going to and coming from a place), especially when a quick return is implied. *Мне надо сходить на почту за письмами. Я съезжу на вокзал и узнаю, когда отходит поезд.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 63.

The suffix "-ся" with some verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another (reciprocal action). Thus: встречаться (to meet), знакомиться (to become acquainted), здороваться (to greet each other) etc. The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "с": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "-ся" the verb встречать — встретить is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.*

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.

exercises.q: One year later, Paul was born.
exercises.why: «The verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups»: reflexive (я моюсь), intransitive (урок продолжается), reciprocal (мы встречаемся), and verbs which never occur without "-ся". — DLI, Lesson 67. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
